owner_thresholds: Latest owner Nov 9 2026: prioritize low false-positive user-facing alerts; supersedes earlier 2%/3% observed-only thresholds. These are rare factual shock screening levels, NOT validated trading forecasts.
scope: V2 research and high-signal alert qualification only; no V1, PAPER/LIVE order or safety-gate edits

price_basis.regular_session: Regular RTH ETF change from 09:30 ET opening trade to latest fully COMPLETED 5min bar close; require two consecutive 5m closes beyond threshold for qualification; never intrabar highs/lows as notification.
price_basis.extended_session: Observed 16:00-20:00 ET SIP and 04:00-09:30 ET SIP; latest two consecutive completed same-session 5m closes vs previous completed RTH close. 20:00-04:00 BOATS historical quote coverage missing: no unsupported certainty.
price_basis.crossover: Regular-session 09:30 bar begins new daytime reference; extended-hours uses previous RTH close
price_basis.missing_data: fail closed; do not conflate unobserved 20:00-04:00 BOATS with zero movement

event_policy.raw_touch: internal research/log-only, NO user push, NO buy/close action
event_policy.qualified_alert: at least TWO consecutive completed 5m ETF closes beyond sector cutoff in same sign; same-timestamp peer breadth >=2/3 for 3 peers, both peers for 2-peer sectors, fresh verified quote + holiday/session; dedupe once per sector direction per session. A crossing is a factual observed shock, NOT a forecast of further price movement.
event_policy.existing_stock_emergency: 2.5% total drop from preceding completed regular close INCLUDING at least 1.0 percentage point in preceding 15 minutes; maintain independent factual warning
event_policy.message_exception: Preserve urgent factual position/stop failures and critical data/broker risk alerts independently of the configured sector-future-prediction mute; do not suppress V1.
event_policy.release_condition: Before enabling any new predictive user alert or broker response, require proven out-of-sample after-signal directional precision, positive after-cost edge with quote-level fills and independent source; a threshold alone cannot establish this.

histogram_source: Alpaca SIP five-minute trade-bar 52-week split adjusted, completed history through Nov6 2026; not full BOATS during 20:00-04:00
status: V2 restrictive low-noise screening thresholds installed for research and prompt filtering. Standalone predictive Pushover and order actions NOT commissioned; existing factual safety alerts preserved.

backtest_summary.notes: Historical backtest already researched; nightly SIP-only missing BOATS; daytime count first qualified sector-day with 2 bars + breadth, 60m prospective outcome 0.5% is NOT a guaranteed fill or profit. Rare events are mostly unprofitable continuation candidates; push/order must stay off.
